# Boston University

> Boston University's comprehensive academic portal offering undergraduate, graduate, and online degree programs across 17+ schools and colleges with research centers and honors opportunities.

Boston University is a major research institution providing access to diverse academic programs, schools, and colleges through a centralized academic hub. The site serves prospective and current students seeking information about degree offerings, program requirements, and academic policies.

## Key Topics

- Degree Programs
- Schools & Colleges
- Graduate Programs
- Undergraduate Programs
- Online Degrees
- Medical School
- Engineering Programs
- College of Arts & Sciences
- College of Communication
- College of Engineering
- BU Hub
- Honors College
- Academic Policies
- Research Centers
- Program Directory

## Academics Overview

- [Academics](https://www.bu.edu/academics): Boston University academics overview covering schools, colleges, and degree programs
- [Schools & Colleges](https://www.bu.edu/academics/schools-colleges): Directory of BU schools and colleges including Medicine, Arts & Sciences, Communication, Engineering, and Fine Arts
- [Degree Programs](https://www.bu.edu/academics/degree-programs): Searchable directory of undergraduate, graduate, and online degree programs across all BU schools

## Online & Extended Learning

- [BU Virtual - Online Degrees and Certificates](https://www.bu.edu/online): BU Virtual online degrees and certificates for working professionals seeking flexible learning options

## Academic Policies & Reference

- [Academic Bulletin](https://www.bu.edu/academics/bulletin): Academic bulletin with policies, requirements, and program specifications for all degree programs

## Research & Centers

- [Centers & Institutes](https://www.bu.edu/research/cf): Directory of Boston University research centers and institutes supporting scholarly inquiry
